location: Nauvis - New Dawn - New Wood Sector
summary: Today was largely the same as yesterday. Most of the time was spent continuing construction and adjustments to the new wood production sector.
The new forestry infrastructure is almost ready to come online, although it still needs a bit more work and some initial kick-starting before it can fully sustain itself.
Once the new wood production sector is operational, I plan to dismantle the older wood infrastructure within the base. Removing the outdated setups should free up valuable space for future expansion.
Another milestone occurred today as the original starter copper deposit was finally depleted.
With the starting deposit exhausted, mining operations have begun shifting fully toward the much larger northern copper deposit, which should provide a far more stable supply moving forward.
Removing the old copper mining infrastructure also cleared a sizable chunk of land within the base perimeter. I will most likely use that space to expand the copper furnace stack in the near future.
Between the ongoing construction work and routine base maintenance, I did not manage to complete any research today.
However, once the new wood sector is fully operational and the base stabilizes again, science production should resume tomorrow.
